14,488 reviews. 4.5 stars. Grand World Phu Quoc is not playing around.

This isn't just a resort complex. It's a full city within Bãi Dài, Phú Quốc. Canals, gondolas, night markets, live performances, and food from every corner of Vietnam, all in one walkable strip.

First-timers always underestimate how much is here. Block out a full evening minimum.
